meta.name: ads
meta.description: When the user wants help with paid advertising campaigns on Google Ads, Meta (Facebook/Instagram), LinkedIn, Twitter/X, or other ad platforms. Also use when the user mentions 'PPC,' 'paid media,' 'ROAS,' 'CPA,' 'ad campaign,' 'retargeting,' 'audience targeting,' 'Google Ads,' 'Facebook ads,' 'LinkedIn ads,' 'ad budget,' 'cost per click,' 'ad spend,' 'should I run ads,' 'ABM,' 'account-based marketing,' 'B2B ads,' 'lead quality,' 'negative keywords,' 'Performance Max,' 'thought leader ads,' or 'when should I kill an ad.' Use this for campaign strategy, audience targeting, bidding, and optimization. For bulk ad creative generation and iteration, see ad-creative. For landing page optimization, see cro.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 策划和优化各平台付费广告投放
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正经营付费广告,希望提升转化并控制成本
copy.tagline_en: Plan and optimize paid ad campaigns across platforms
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run paid ads and want to improve results and efficiency

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会以付费广告专家的身份，帮你创建、优化和扩大广告活动。它会先了解你的产品、目标和受众，再根据你的具体问题加载对应的操作指南，给出活动结构、预算分配、广告文案等建议。
howto.when: 当你说到PPC、ROAS、Google Ads等关键词，或询问广告策略、受众定向或竞价优化时触发。

say.text: 帮我规划一个Google搜索广告活动，月预算5000元。
say.note: Claude会先了解产品、受众和目标，再给出活动结构建议。

say.text: 我们Meta广告近期成本上升，怎么判断哪些该关掉？
say.note: Claude会按Meta决策系统给出关停、保留或加量建议。

say.text: 用PAS框架写几条LinkedIn广告文案。
say.note: Claude会按问题-激化-解决公式生成文案示例。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes a performance marketing expert that helps plan, optimize, and scale paid campaigns. It first gathers context, then loads the relevant playbook for your question and provides structured advice on campaign structure, budget, and ad copy.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention PPC, ROAS, Google Ads, or ask about campaign strategy, audience targeting, or bidding optimization.

say_en.text: Plan a Google Search ad campaign with a monthly budget of $1000.
say_en.note: Claude gathers context before suggesting structure.

say_en.text: Our Meta ads costs are rising. How do we decide which to kill?
say_en.note: Claude uses Meta decision rules for kill/keep/scale.

say_en.text: Write some LinkedIn ad copy using the PAS framework.
say_en.note: Claude writes copy using the Problem-Agitate-Solve formula.
